children.textContent: Five countries have published stories so far. The map tracks the rest. No padding, no placeholder countries, no cities we did not actually walk.
Banitsa in Sofia, one stop on a fourteen-day, twelve-country EV road trip with a Samoyed.
Christmas on the W Trek in Torres del Paine, measured in Camp Italianos.
Easter in Accra, where the whole country wears white. We did not get the memo.
Switchbacks out of Podgorica, semi-trucks in reverse, and fresh fish in Budva.
Whale sharks, sea lions who chose chaos, and marine biology students who made it better.
File a story and put a pin in it. A human reviews it within 48 hours, edited lightly.
Be the first to tell us about it →
Every country the founder has been to, on the map, with the story behind the pin.
